Hi Jamie / Alex —

Thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- What we heard: primary use case is real-time customer support augmentation (short-form responses, knowledge retrieval from internal KB), target latency < 500ms for critical flows, sensitive PII redaction required, and preference for private deployment in AWS us-west-2.
- Success metrics: reduce average handle time by 20–30% and maintain answer accuracy > 92% on first-pass responses.
- Constraints: budget window Q4, procurement prefers a 12-month committed contract.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Technical deep-dive (30–45 min) with our SE to validate architecture and data flow — Dev is cc'd; can you share availability next week?
2) We’ll put together a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) with milestones and a rough cost estimate.
3) If fit looks good after the deep-dive, we can schedule a pilot (4–6 weeks) on dedicated capacity.

Attaching the discovery notes and a draft MAP (one-pager).

If timing has changed on your side, please let me know — we can adjust.

Best,
